mcpb_description: Àtte yi àttekaay yi def (décisions de justice) ak yoon yi (législation), jóge ci sit internet yu Nguur gi ak yu àttekaay yi ci lu ëpp 120 juridiction, ñu jël ko ci saa si, ak lëkkalekaay (lien) bu jëm ci mbind mu njëkk mi.
mcpb_long_description: Fontes dafay jël àtte yi àttekaay yi def (décisions de justice) ak yoon yi ci saa si ci cosaan yu Nguur gi ci waxtu wi nga laaj, te bépp njeexital am na lëkkalekaay (lien) bu jëm ci mbind mu njëkk mi. Extension bii ab tàmbalikaay bu tuuti la: bu tàmbalee yoon wu jëkk, dafay yeb Fontes ci PyPI ak uv, te ginnaaw loolu dafay ko yeesal benn yoon ci bés bi ci ginnaaw, te saa su jafe-jafe amee, dafay dellu ci sumb bu mujj bi doxoon.
mcpb_tool_list_jurisdictions: Lim juridiction yi (réew ak àttekaay yu adduna) ñu am, seen cosaan, jumtukaay ak filtre.
mcpb_tool_search_caselaw: Wut ci mbind mépp ci àtte yi àttekaay yi def ci benn juridiction.
mcpb_tool_get_decision: Jël benn àtte (décision de justice) ci markdown ak URL bu cosaan bi.
mcpb_tool_search_legislation: Wut yoon yi (lois, actes, textes réglementaires) ci benn juridiction.
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_toc: Tabalu xaaj yi (sommaire) ci benn yoon, ak turu xaaj yi (articles).
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_provision: Mbind mu léegi mi ci benn xaaj (article walla section).
mcpb_tool_get_legislation_text: Mbind mépp mu ñu yeesal (texte consolidé) ci benn yoon, ci xët yu bare.
mcpb_tool_report_bug: Waajal benn yégle njuumte (bug) ci Fontes; dees koy yónne rekk su jëfandikookat bi dëggalee.
